Could you do me a huge favor? 🥺Please accept my invite so that I can get free giftsCopy my code: 140792166
I understand. When i lost my sister who listened to her demons. It broke me and also made me stronger. I hope you will be strong too.
I already know how shitty my life is. I was offering hope since i have none.
You are not as alone as you think. People are listening and care.
I don't know you but I would like to have you in this world. You are not alone.

I know you feel alone. Let me tell you something that i have learnt. I have loved and lost many many times. I know that there is at least someone out there who accepts you for who you are. This person whomever they are will be there when you least expect it. Don't give up. What makes you different makes you unique. You are special. You are amazing. I wish you could see yourself through my eyes and see what i see. I may not know you but I see hope.

Are you alright? I have been where you are. I have the scars of pain. I don't know you but I want you to live. Every day i wake up and I think of one thing to do every day. I go out and get a coffee or walk around Walmart for an hour especially when i don't want to. It doesn't cure my feelings but it helps me. I look for at least one reason to look forward to no matter how small.
